annotations.title: Check a draft against my policies

description: Advisory check of a draft reply, plan or action against your department's Dactic policies. Returns findings that quote the policy and the draft verbatim, with a suggested change, and says how many policies were checked. Present the result as advice: it is never a compliance sign-off. not_assessed means the check couldn't run; the applicable policies are listed instead.
name: check_against_policy
title: Check a draft against my policies
